desc: 雾灰山景首屏承接，营养参数、晾晒微距与三种食法场景建立滋补信任
name: 高山云雾自然晾晒玛咖干片款

shots.intent: 首屏以雾灰山景加木台陈设完成一眼种草，竖排主张承接搜索点击。
shots.textZone: upper right vertical two-line headline zone with a small rounded origin tag above and one thin horizontal support line below

shots.intent: 双列点线参数卡交代规格产地贮藏等硬信息，消除选购疑虑。
shots.textZone: centered section header frame with headline and sub-line; below it two tidy columns of dotted spec rows, 4 rows per column, each row pairing a short label with one short example value

shots.intent: 深咖底上罐体与通用表头营养表并列，以成分透明完成信任背书，真实数据由使用方填入。
shots.textZone: right column header above the table; a table with four generic column headers and five short rows of example values; one thin usage line below the table

shots.intent: 蓝色山峦大景加盘中干片双栏并置，让买家代入高海拔源头环境。
shots.textZone: a vertical rounded text panel on the left image edge holding a vertical headline and one short support line

shots.intent: 高角度侧光微距呈现干片深色外缘与米白切面，证明晾晒质地。
shots.textZone: small vertical rounded text panel with a vertical headline and one short line; no other text

shots.intent: 低角度微距呈现整果皱纹肌理与自然形态，补足原料可信度。
shots.textZone: small vertical rounded text panel with a vertical headline and one short line; no other text

shots.intent: 玻璃杯中干片沉底冲泡的日常一幕，演示最主线的代用茶食法。
俯拍砂锅炖汤里浮着干片，展示入膳食法并放大家常食欲。
蜂蜜拉丝与干片小碟同框，补足调饮食法并收束日常全场景。
深咖底加实色行动按钮收口，引导下单或入会动作。
shots.textZone: right side: short headline above the button, button text, one thin support line below the button
